style: psychedelic pop and acid-folk color, funk and soul band language, doo-wop and vocal-group pop. HARMONY: barbershop-style voice leading with ringing dominant tension, bitonal layers that retain separate tonal centers, diatonic sweetness repeatedly interrupted by non-diatonic clusters. MELODIC: ornamental folk turns and call-and-response phrases, fast scat-like contour with clipped consonant attacks. RHYTHM: deep funk pocket with syncopated sixteenth-note displacement, waltz pulse invaded by duple accents, stuttering stop-start punk rhythm with hard silences. TIMBRE: fuzz guitar, cheap organ, tambourine, and room bleed, upright bass, brushed percussion, vibraphone, and breathy reeds. PERFORMANCE: theatrical overstatement played completely straight, joyous competitive call-and-response, ecstatic and physically committed. ANCHOR: a constant ringing acoustic guitar strum that holds the celestial coordinate.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Bright brass fanfare]
[Doo-wop nonsense vocables in stacked harmony]
Sha-la-la-la-dimensional shift!
[Funky bassline enters]
[Verse 1]
Filing cabinet seven-eight-alpha is hovering
Sixteen thousand eyes are officially registering
Through the prismatic corridor of rhombic display
Please present your permit for existing today
The tesseract turns on a bureaucratic hinge
While rainbow glitter makes the audit unhinged
[Chorus]
Oh, the Merkaba spins with a procedural grace
Tripping balls across the astral marketplace!
Glittering geometry! Prismatic geometry!
Sign the triplicate form for the golden theology!
[Verse 2]
Sensory freak detects a probability debt
Of five billion angels we haven't audited yet
Their wings are composed of non-Euclidean sighs
Filed under Subsection Four of the skies
The color is purple, the tax rate is mild
Every single dimension is legally filed
[Bridge]
[A Cappella hocketing]
[Spoken Cosmic Clerk]: Step back from the infinite edge
[Sung Gospel Melisma]: You are blocking the maintenance wedge!
[Drop into heavy funk pocket]
[Guitar fuzz solo with spring reverb]
[Verse 3]
Ten thousand vertices sparkling bright
Tripping on photons of administrative light
A biblically accurate wheel within a wheel
Certified organic and totally real
The paperwork glows with an ultraviolet hue
We are checking the math on the infinite you
[Chorus]
Oh, the Merkaba spins with a procedural grace
Tripping balls across the astral marketplace!
Glittering geometry! Prismatic geometry!
Sign the triplicate form for the golden theology!
[Outro]
[Fuzz guitar fades into wind chimes]
[Dry deadpan spoken narration]: Audit complete. Have a nice eternity.
[Silence]
caption: An ecstatic collision of acid-folk color, funky basslines, and barbershop vocal harmony narrating a psychedelic encounter with a bureaucratic, tesseract-shaped angelic entity. The track maps impossible interdimensional geometry through deadpan administrative regulation, blending high-energy funk grooves with intricate vocal hocketing and shimmering prismatic guitar textures.
